clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Great Sea, Erion's Behest carries a summons to promising night elf rogues in Darnassus. Erion Shadewhisper sees their growing skill in stealth and sends them to Stormwind City to report to Stormwind Intelligence.

Night elf rogues in Teldrassil's shadow train under mentors such as Erion Shadewhisper. When one shows exceptional talent, word reaches beyond the World Tree. Through Erion, Stormwind Intelligence, known as SI:7, invites the rogue across the Great Sea to the human capital.

The journey leads from northern Kalimdor through the docks of Darkshore or the Wetlands to Stormwind City. In the capital, you make your way to SI:7 headquarters in Old Town and report to Renzik "The Shiv." He assesses newcomers and opens the way to advanced espionage, poison mastery, and covert operations for the Alliance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Word of your deeds has spread far and wide, friend. So far, in fact, that Stormwind Intelligence has asked for you by name.
The journey is taxing and not without peril, but an opportunity to train under SI:7 should not be taken lightly.
A new world awaits you, friend. Make your way to Old Town in Stormwind and speak with Renzik "The Shiv" at SI:7 headquarters.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have answered SI:7's calling, friend and journeyed from distant shores to join our ranks, however, there is much for you to learn.
